title: Selfune Decision Chain
description: One hiring decision as a chain: role need -> requirement -> evidence -> decision. Every link carries its own verdict. The chain is only as strong as its weakest link. It describes the PROCESS, never the person.

candidate_ref.description: Anonymous ID only. Never a name.

weakest_link.description: link_id of the first link that is not VERIFIED, or null when all are VERIFIED.

blocked.description: True when C9 (emotion or personality inference) fired anywhere in the chain. A blocked chain is not evaluated further.

observed.description: What is actually in the data (evidence links).

inferred.description: What was concluded from it (evidence links).

observed_confidence.description: Is the observed fact really in the data? (from ERD: Behavior Confidence)

inference_confidence.description: Does the fact support the conclusion? (from ERD: Explanation Confidence)

alternative_explanations.description: Other readings of the same fact (from ERD).

trait_ref.description: Role-memory trait_id used to verify a requirement.

ask.description: Under 25 words, specific to the employer's data.

why.description: What stays unverified without the answer.

do_not_ask.description: Leading or loaded phrasings to avoid (from ERD: What NOT to Ask).
